I handed over the old cup and asked the barista to pour it out and just make me a new order. The partner was incredibly attentive because he noticed the cup was completely full and politely asked what had happened.
When I explained that the previous location used the wrong espresso blend, he asked where I had bought it and offered me a replacement completely free of charge.

For many of us in Toronto, the Second Cup was really the first easily accessible cafe where we could experience specialty coffee . These days, the SecondCup locations have dwindled, but the Bloor West location has a good community vibe and quite a nice back patio. The barista's are friendly, efficient and produce a good cup of coffee.

On this visit, I came in specifically to have an eggnog latte,a seasonal offering which personally I find is a necessary part of the Christmas season. Many cafés produce an eggnog latte with combinations of sweet, artificial syrups, but the SecondCup uses real eggnog, gently steamed, and then the addition of a good strong espresso shot.

I think my drink was executed perfectly, and it was a lovely addition to the Christmas season.
